thread:
Mia: Quick kickoff — pre-launch SEO sweep for the benchmark post + webinar landing. Need a short checklist and owners, target: next Wed EOD. Who can take redirects, schema, internal linking, and inbound routing?

Sanjay: I can own redirects + canonicalization. Will produce a CSV map and a small nginx rule set. Will need a list of old URLs to route from.

Terri: I’ll draft FAQ schema and FAQ content blocks for both post + landing. Can we include 3–5 high-intent question prompts?

Alex: I’ll handle UTM/lead routing and webinar landing canonical + redirect testing. Also I’ll wire the landing into HubSpot routing rules (UTM -> persona).

Jordan: Can we get a quick priority list? My asks: 1) redirect map 2) canonical + hreflang (if needed) 3) schema (FAQ + Article) 4) internal link placements 5) analytics goals + UTMs.

Sanjay: Priority noted. Quick redirect CSV example I’ll produce — will follow this shape:

```csv
old_url,new_url,status,reason,owner
/products/old-benchmark,/blog/benchmark-2026,301,canonicalize content,redwood-seo
/webinar/reg-old,/webinar/benchmark-q2,302,consolidate registration,redwood-seo
```

Mia: That CSV shape is perfect. Add a column for `test_path` for QA notes if the redirect is only toggled during rollout.

Sanjay: Good call — will add `test_path`. Also nginx snippet for the quick test env: 

```nginx
server {
  listen 80;
  location = /products/old-benchmark {
    return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/blog/benchmark-2026;
  }
}
```

Terri: For schema: Article schema + FAQ schema. Draft questions: 
- What is the Redwood Benchmark and why it matters?
- How do you reproduce the benchmark locally?
- What are the latency/cost tradeoffs demonstrated?

Terri: I’ll author the JSON-LD snippets and paste them into the CMS template block, plus a small accordion for the FAQ on the landing.

Alex: Routing notes — use utm_source=benchmark-email / utm_campaign=benchmark-q2 / utm_medium=email. For webinar signups, include `lead_source=webinar-benchmark` in hidden field so HubSpot can route to SDR queue A. I’ll add a GTM event for `benchmark_signup`.

Jordan: Who will check internal linking (onsite contextual links from product pages -> benchmark + webinar)? We should do 8–10 high-value links.

Mia: Terri + Alex pair on internal linking. Terri picks anchor text, Alex deploys links and tracks via clicks.

seo-bot: Lighthouse report scheduled -> https://ci.redwood/seo/lighthouse/1923456789 (will post results when ready).

Sanjay: I’ll also add a redirect fallback policy for expired webinar paths (soft 302 to blog or registration archive).

Mia: Timeline:
- Today: owners confirmed (done)
- Tue noon: drafts for schema + redirect CSV + UTM plan
- Tue EOD: QA pass on staging redirects + canonical checks
- Wed EOD: production redirects + publish landing + monitor analytics for first 24h

Alex: I’ll set the monitoring dashboard and add a spike alert for registration rate vs expected.

Terri: Will drop first draft of FAQ + JSON-LD by Tue morning.

Sanjay: Redirect CSV and nginx test rules by Tue morning.

Mia: Amazing — thanks team. Quick micro-task: add any edge-case redirects to the CSV (trailing slashes, www/non-www, query variants). :thumbsup:

Alex: Noted. I’ll also ensure canonical points to the production landing and add `rel=canonical` in the CMS head template.

Jordan: Putting a quick checklist in the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/benchmark-seo-launch (edit rights to team).

Mia: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me. Closing thread after we confirm Tue noon deliverables. :rocket:
